Subject: Need help with a cross-border insolvency case

Hello, my name is Ravi Sethi. I am a 58-year-old railway employee living in Panaji. Our company is owed Rs 16,50,00,000 by M/s Meridian Industries, which is insolvent here and abroad, and the debtor is in insolvency proceedings in two countries. My case number is C.P.(IB) No. 1419/2019 in the NCLT Mumbai. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on 90575 33886 or email ravi.sethi@example.in.
